issues.title: Harbor berth allocation
established_facts: Established shipowners seek predictable priority at newer quays during crowded seasons.
Smaller traders and river interests fear temporary priority becoming permanent privilege.

issues.title: Warehouse fire precautions
established_facts: Small fires and near-misses have prompted safety measures.
Cause of fires is unknown.
possible_paths: Further incidents if an actual cause remains unaddressed
escalation_conditions: Evidence of deliberate fire-setting or a new incident could change the issue

issues.title: Northfield harvest
established_facts: Harvest expected adequate but uneven.
Some farms report damage and labor shortages.
No famine is established.
possible_paths: Adequate harvest with local winners and losers

issues.title: Ratfolk market access
established_facts: Ratfolk traders seek regular stalls and recognized leases.
Some merchants support access and others resist changing established practice.
Ratfolk networks differ over advocacy, gradual negotiation, and household safety.
No comprehensive Denvor ruling exists.
Ratfolk have petition access but no guaranteed Council seat.

issues.title: Denvor household priorities
established_facts: Household discussions concern future influence, defense investment, and family direction.
Oswin favors caution; Edwyn presses for investment; Anwen builds civic and commercial relationships.
No open succession crisis exists.
Edwyn is the recognized heir.

issues.title: Kharadorn harbor-defense review
established_facts: Kharadorn requested updated defense accounts and review of harbor defenses and charter obligations.
This is legitimate oversight, not an established pretext for occupation.
Findings and remedies are not yet known.

issues.title: Skilled labor, credit, and supply
established_facts: Skilled labor and merchant credit are under pressure.
Late deliveries, debts, quality concerns, and contracts create fragmented disputes.
No common scheme or single cause is established.
unknowns: Named debtors and creditors beyond established contacts

issues.title: Longmead boundary dispute
established_facts: Harrowden and Wrenford dispute customary grazing and woodland rights.
No armed clash, killing, raid, eviction, or formal seizure has occurred.
Neither side has submitted a complete formal claim with mutually accepted evidence.

projects.objective: Review harbor chain and boom, defensive positions, ship/transport records, defense stores, maintenance plans, and whether trade growth outpaced defenses.

projects.sponsor: Warehouse Guild; Meret Sorn; affected owners
projects.objective: Improve fire precautions and inspection after small fires and near-misses.

projects.title: Harbor allocation arrangement
projects.sponsor: Harbor Fellowship; Harbor Master Ysella Vane; smaller traders and river interests
projects.objective: Establish predictable quay access during crowded seasons without entrenching permanent privilege.

projects.title: Northfield harvest monitoring
projects.sponsor: Northfield farms and grain merchants; Denvor administration as relevant
projects.objective: Assess uneven harvest, farm damage, labor shortages, and likely grain supply.

projects.title: Denvor defense and infrastructure priorities
projects.sponsor: House Denvor; Oswin and Edwyn hold differing preferences
projects.objective: Determine investment priorities while preserving city security and fiscal stability.

projects.title: Northern Watch autumn provisioning
projects.objective: Prepare stores, transport, and supply arrangements before winter conditions worsen.

projects.title: Edarth banner rolls and service review
projects.objective: Review sworn-house obligations, service records, unresolved petitions, and related customary disputes.

projects.title: Crownland road and courier service review
projects.objective: Review royal messengers, relay stables, road maintenance, and Crownland service obligations.

projects.title: Western Pass commercial terms review
projects.objective: Review trade access, route reliability, commercial guarantees, and Western Pass terms.

projects.title: Eastern Coast pilotage and harbor-practice review
projects.objective: Gather reports from smaller ports and pilot houses before considering maritime-practice changes.

projects.title: Brightwater river-market charter review
projects.objective: Reassess market and river-use rules as trade volume and neighboring interests change.

relationships.condition: Crown needs Vaelorian financial support; Vaelorian expects influence in return.
Kharadorn preserves strategic control over key inland-sea routes while Merrowen seeks freer navigation.
Edarth resists royal centralization; Crown seeks gradual expansion of authority.
Veyr seeks reliable southern resources and Crown support for northern needs.
The houses cooperate commercially while competing for trade influence.
Kharadorn recognizes the post-Rebellion settlement but does not consider itself subject to the Crown.
The houses share a natural military understanding.
Established mutual respect; no alliance is implied.

established_elements: The old dragon-riding dynasty and twelve-dragon historical peak are established canon.
The fate and future relevance of surviving dragons remain unresolved.
The wider world is not necessarily fully known.
Dothraki are established as orcs, known to the wider world, and feared.

The world may eventually change substantially.
undetermined_elements: Whether the transformation is political, military, economic, environmental, supernatural, geographic, or a combination
global_transformation.evaluation_rule: Monitor accumulated conditions, emerging pressures, plausible triggers, and materially different futures. Create a world fork only when the evidence supports a genuine divergence.
